method: all eight captured on ONE deployed SHA through the real customer journey, then diagnosed OFFLINE from the artifacts. Zero live analyses were spent on diagnosis.

mechanical_audit.note: case A and the archetype fallback both hold: 'Who's the real competitor?' is identical on 0 of 28 pairs.

instrument_corrections.error: chrome truncation applied to a whole ROUTE
instrument_corrections.symptom: Meta/Amazon slides and full both scored 1.000
instrument_corrections.cause: a 6,333-character page was truncated at its first boilerplate marker, comparing 454 characters of opening banner
instrument_corrections.lesson: a route is not an answer; strip chrome, do not truncate

instrument_corrections.error: the bare word 'next' used as a chrome marker
instrument_corrections.symptom: 'What should we measure next?' identical on 28 of 28
instrument_corrections.cause: the QUESTION contains 'next', so every answer truncated to 'what should we measure ' — an instrument that had stopped measuring
instrument_corrections.lesson: a bare common word is not a marker; verify the instrument hardest when it produces the most dramatic number

qa_collapse_pairs_of_10.shared: BOTH REFUSED — not a shared pattern
nothing — the floor, and the control

root_cause.finding: EIGHT OF THE TEN board questions this programme asks reached no intent in the Q&A router. They fell to the strategic catch-all, which answers from the matched pattern's own text.
root_cause.evidence: the two questions that DID route — 'What's the biggest risk?' and 'Who's the real competitor?' — are the two that did not collapse; competitor is 0 of 28
two_of_the_misses_were_trivial: the falsifier marker required 'proveS this wrong'; the board asks 'What WOULD prove this wrong?' — one character
the monitoring marker knew 'monitor next' and not 'measure next'
root_cause.the_refusal: Eli Lilly and Walmart answered eight questions with 'I am not going to give you a strategic read on this company' while their own introductions rendered 'Our read: Bounded' and a real central question. The trailing clause — 'the same reason the summary above withheld it' — cites a refusal no longer being made.
root_cause.one_gap: one router gap produced two collapse clusters and one cross-surface contradiction, which had been treated as three separate defects

repair.shape: cluster-first: the router once, not three renderers
changes: all ten board questions now route
four intents added: why_now, market_belief, weakest_assumption, impossible_hypothesis
recommendation hears management and the board
a routed answer still carries its grounding — the early return had started skipping it
guards: no two intents may declare one field
no marker may be a bare common word
every intent needs markers, a field and an honest absent sentence

still_open.successor_defect: two companies sharing a top pattern still share the pattern's own text where a question routes to a field the decision fills from it. The router repair removes the CATCH-ALL half; composition from the company's own evidence is the other.
still_open.measured_by_the_other_session: selection cannot close it: 2 options in 11 of 12 patterns, ONE gap in 11 of 12, and a lexical selector scored 0.000 on five of six fields because the scaffold speaks strategic vocabulary and the evidence speaks company vocabulary
